resources.string: BetterChoice: open a food product to see its A, B or C rating.
Allow BetterChoice to rate food in shopping apps

BetterChoice uses Android Accessibility for two things.

1. Show the bubble: it checks which app is in front, using window information and the app's package name, so the bubble appears only in Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Swiggy Instamart, Zomato and Flipkart.

2. Rate food: while one of those apps is open, it reads the text on product pages (name, price, nutrition and ingredients, including sections you open such as Product details or Highlights) and takes a screenshot of the screen while that app is open to read the visible pack photo. Photo text is recognised on this phone with Google ML Kit. Screenshots and screen text are processed in memory and discarded straight away; they are never saved, uploaded or used to build a shopping history. Password fields are never read, and payment screens are never rated or photographed.

If a food page cannot be read, the bubble asks you to open the ingredients or the pack photo. You can skip any item.

If no nutrition is found on screen, the product name, price and app are sent to the BetterChoice database to look the item up. If you choose Add details, the values you type, the product name, price, app and your account ID are sent for review so other shoppers benefit. Your email or phone number and optional profile are handled by our sign-in and profile service. Google ML Kit may send anonymous usage and performance statistics to Google; it does not send screen content.

BetterChoice does not read the content of other apps, messages or passwords, and never taps or types for you.

Next, choose BetterChoice India bubble in Android Accessibility settings and switch it on. You can withdraw consent with Turn off BetterChoice or by disabling it in Settings.

Keep the BetterChoice India bubble service on in Accessibility settings. Leave its optional shortcut off. If a button stays at the edge of your Home screen, open Manage or disable access, select BetterChoice India bubble and turn off only its shortcut. The BC bubble works automatically while you shop.

Works only inside Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Swiggy Instamart, Zomato and Flipkart. Android sends it nothing from any other app, and it never opens another app\'s screen. There it shows the BetterChoice bubble and rates packaged food A, B or C. On product pages it reads the product name, price and nutrition text, and takes screenshots of only the shopping app\'s part of the screen, to read pack photos on your phone. Screen content is not saved or uploaded; only the product name, price and app may be sent to look up nutrition. Never reads password fields, and never rates or photographs payment screens. Never taps or types for you.

Sign-in: your email or mobile number is sent to our sign-in service (Supabase) to deliver a one-time code and create or access your account. Email and SMS providers deliver the code.

Profile: every answer is optional. Saved answers sync to your account and are encrypted in this app's private storage. You can edit or clear them, sign out, or delete your account.

Ratings: after you separately allow Accessibility, BetterChoice reads food product pages and pack photos only inside the supported shopping apps. This happens on your phone and nothing from your screen is stored. If no nutrition is visible, the product name, price and app are used to look the item up in the BetterChoice database. Details you choose to add are shared for review with your account ID.

BetterChoice is for adults 18+. Ratings are a guide based on published nutrient scoring, not medical advice. No advertising or selling of your data.

For beta support or privacy requests, contact the person who invited you to test BetterChoice.
